name: action-home-assistant
description: Fire a Home Assistant webhook automation from any PersonalClaw trigger. Point it at your HA instance, then give each action the webhook id to call.

x-meta.label: Home Assistant URL
x-meta.help: Your HA instance, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123. Required: without it every action fails with a named error.

x-meta.label: Request Timeout
x-meta.help: Maximum seconds to wait for Home Assistant to answer.
